text:
maria-eng: Quick check — oslo-1 region expansion. Need a short status update on routing/peering, KMS residency, and a canary window. Planning to flip traffic next Tue.
jonathan-platform: Pinged infra checklist last week. Main open items: cross-account peering, DNS TTL update, and S3 endpoint policy for logs.
kevin-netops: I own peering + route policies. Peering request filed (PR #4523) but waiting on cloud acct approvals. ETA 48h once approvals in.
anya-security: KMS + data residency: final compliance signoff pending. I flagged key policy for review. Need the exact list of bucket ARNs and whether audit logs go to customer-managed projects.
lisa-prodops: Canary window proposal: 2-hour ramp starting 03:00 UTC Fri -> 10% -> 50% -> rollback at any error. We need smoke jobs green and runbook updated.
praveen-sre: I can run the smoke jobs. Asked for Terraform plan to validate routing and health checks. Also need the canary Django sample load profile.
kevin-netops: Sharing route policy snippet now:```yaml
route_table: oslo-1-public
routes:
  - prefix: 0.0.0.0/0
    target: igw-oslo-1
  - prefix: 10.0.0.0/16
    target: vpn-peer-12345
priority: 100
```
kevin-netops: Also added a BGP community to prefer local egress, put a note in PR.
maria-eng: @kevin-netops thanks — did you validate the path MTU for the peer? We had packet drops in staging last month.
kevin-netops: Good catch. Did basic MTU probe (mtr) — no fragmentation observed, but will run extended for 24h and post results.
anya-security: @lisa-prodops for the runbook, include KMS rollback step: revoke key rotation and fallback to global-managed key if anything fails. I'll share exact commands.
lisa-prodops: ack. Adding steps and a checklist item: confirm audit logs landing.
praveen-sre: Smoke job checklist: healthcheck /metrics endpoint, prefix cache warm, model kv-store connectivity test. I added a quick script:```bash
./smoke.sh --region oslo-1 --checks health,kv,metrics
```
jonathan-platform: Owners summary for the ticket: routing=kevin-netops, kms=anya-security, canary= lisa-prodops + praveen-sre, infra automation=jonathan-platform. Can we get final thumbs by EOD?
maria-eng: I'll coordinate stakeholder email and timeline. @anya-security and @kevin-netops please drop approval or blockers.
kevin-netops: Approve from netops side once cloud account approves PR #4523. Noted blocker.
anya-security: Approve pending KMS key policy tweak (will post change set). If that's small, we can signoff today.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: TF plan applied to staging-oslo-1 (plan id: tf-20240315-776), no changes to production.
lisa-prodops: deploy-bot smoke results look good for staging. @praveen-sre can you run the extended smoke at 22:30 UTC?
praveen-sre: Scheduling extended smoke at 22:30 UTC. Will post logs here.
maria-eng: Thanks team. I'll update the ticket with the canary timeline and invite stakeholders. If no major blockers by EOD, target traffic flip Tue as planned. :thumbsup:
